name: National Innovation Visa (subclass 858)

selection_odds.basis: Expression of Interest to invitation rate since program commencement — approximately 9,000 EOIs submitted, 304 invitations issued, roughly 85 visas granted as of this verification

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an internationally recognised record of exceptional and outstanding achievement in an eligible field — research, business, technology, sport, or the arts — evidenced through concrete markers (senior/founding roles, published research with citation weight, national/international awards, patents or measurable-impact products, elite sporting representation).
requirements.fix_path: Build and document a track record of internationally recognised achievement in a target sector.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a nominator with a national reputation in your field — an Australian citizen, permanent resident, eligible New Zealand citizen, or Australian organisation.
This requires being under 45 at application, unless meeting a specified exemption (e.g. income above a high-income threshold in 2 of the last 3 years).

evidence_required.document: Evidence portfolio of internationally recognised achievement (awards, publications, patents, media coverage, financial/impact metrics)
Nomination letter from a qualified nominator

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — permanent visa on grant, with travel facility for 5 years

sources.title: National Innovation visa (subclass 858) - Department of Home Affairs

notes: MAJOR STRUCTURAL FINDING, the single largest business/investor-route change found across this entire multi-country dataset: Australia's dedicated Business Innovation and Investment Program (subclass 188, the closest Australian equivalent to a 'Golden Visa') CLOSED TO NEW APPLICANTS on 31 July 2024 — with NO direct successor investor visa. Separately, the Global Talent visa (also subclass 858) was replaced on 6 December 2024 by this National Innovation Visa, which now absorbs BOTH the former talent-visa function AND whatever investor-migration appetite the old BIIP served, under a single, extremely selective, invitation-only, no-fixed-investment-threshold model. This is structurally the opposite of the investment-threshold model used by every European investor-adjacent route in this dataset (Portugal Golden Visa €500k, Spain's now-abolished Golden Visa, France's investor Talent Passport category) — Australia has moved decisively AWAY from 'pay X, get residence' toward 'prove exceptional achievement, get invited,' with a brutal 6.6% EOI-to-invitation rate. Any secondary source describing an active 'Australia Golden Visa' or subclass 188 investor pathway as currently open is describing a closed program — a clean, high-confidence counterfeit-figure case, structurally similar to Spain's fully-abolished Golden Visa (es_golden_visa) but achieved through consolidation into a talent visa rather than outright abolition with no successor. Existing BIIP holders/pending applications from before 31 July 2024 continue under the old rules — not encoded here since this file represents the current path for new applicants.
